description: Columbus, MS — One year ago this week, Cindy Hyde-Smith voted to hand a permanent tax break to billionaires and helped pay for it by taking nearly $1 trillion out of Medicaid and CHIP nationwide, the largest cut in the program's history. A year later, the receipt is in, and Mississippi is paying the costs.

title: BY THE NUMBERS: One Year After Cindy Hyde-Smith Voted for the Billionaire Tax Break, It Is Draining More Than $11 Billion From Mississippi's Medicaid and the Rural Hospitals Families Depend On - Scott Colom for Senate
